name: generate-design-skill
description: Mode-based skill pack for an HTML-only design generator: /design to enter design mode (explicit, like /chat). When ON, every turn composes skills for single index.html output, one page per run, freeform tweaks, DESIGN.md baton. When OFF, no injection.
source: Distilled from Open CoDesign (https://github.com/OpenCoworkAI/open-codesign), MIT License — prompt sections packages/core/src/prompts/sections/*.md and skills apps/desktop/resources/templates/skills/{craft-polish,frontend-design-anti-slop,responsive-layout}.md

activation.when: /design enters design mode (persists per session via custom entry generate-design-mode). When ON, every turn composes skills — fresh (workflow + output rules + anti-slop + commitment + polish + plan gate) or tweak (revision-tweaks + rules + anti-slop) based on index.html existence. Input that looks like design work nudges to enable. Exit with /design-off.
activation.blockedWhen: design mode OFF — no prompt injection and no trigger scanning (except a lightweight nudge). design_check tool and /design-check command remain available.

systemPromptWhenDesignMode.when: design mode ON + fresh run (no index.html) — plan gate required before HTML
design mode ON — always (fresh and tweak)
design mode ON — inline DESIGN.md head as constraint; create/update after write
design mode ON + fresh run — final self-check before finish
design mode ON + tweak run (index.html exists) — minimum coherent change
